column1: Remaining lease of flat is at least 20 years and can cover the youngest buyer up to the age of 95

column2: The amount is capped at the lower of the value of flat or price of the flat at the time of purchase.

The amount is pro-rated based on the extent the remaining lease of the flat can cover the youngest buyer up to the age of 95. When the allowed CPF amount is used up, buyers will have to pay the balance flat purchase price and/ or monthly mortgage instalments in cash. This will help buyers set aside CPF savings for their housing needs during retirement (e.g. buying a replacement property).
